name: smwmusic-barrage-musical-a-fantasy-of-tempest-the-world-fairy-only-knows
title: Barrage Musical ~ A Fantasy of Tempest ~ - The World Fairy Only Knows
description:
Sindy's theme from Barrage Musical, a Touhou clone with a focus on synchronizing everything to the music. The music is also Touhou-styled, with this song probably being one of the most Touhou-sounding in the game.

It's a happy-sounding song, and feels magical just like a little fairy flying around, shooting bullets would.

I believe I've seen the title translated as "A World Only Fairies Understand" as well, but I named the submission after the official in-game English name.
